_comment: REAL SHAPE, extra usage switched OFF. `is_enabled: false` is the whole answer and the row must be ABSENT — never `0.00 USD spent`, and never a `0 / 5000 (0%)` bar: a cap the owner has not opted into is not a cap he has spent nothing against. Note the block still carries a used_credits figure and a limit, which is exactly why the flag is read strictly (`=== true`) rather than the amounts being trusted on their own.
